status: DRAFT, not frozen: freeze = commit this file + situations.json + scenarios/ to so-sessions (or the plan's Gate record) before the first inference, then never edit; any change is a new corpus id

corpus.offlineCheck: check.mjs: parseStory + runDiagnostics + anchorCandidates/stakesLines/offerRows/makeScreen from the repo source (esbuild bundle, harness/engine.mjs) over a simulated seed; expect.computed holds the result; every leak needle absent from projection, panel rows and anchor texts

current.meaning: pre-06 suggestions: no anchor block, no tags (seam NOT built yet; must also decide whether help line / greyed offers / verbatim offers are off in this arm)

anchored.meaning: shipped 06: anchors, tags, help line, greyed offers, verbatim dropped offer

runProtocol: LT window authorized by the owner; real memory model on the read role, thinking and inner voice on; ONE model lane (2026-10-22 two-lane run timed out on GPU sharing).
Lane seeded fresh from the owner install (synthetic stories, no adolion-fresh needed); images and sprites off (the scenarios also write those leaves).
Per situation run both arms back to back on the same lane; arm order alternates by situation number (odd: current first, even: anchored first).

node scripts/debug/st-lanes.mts run <n> -- scripts/debug/so-scenario.mts run <file> --sandbox --group 'Group: Arin, DM Narrator' for each of the 80 files; a guard-step failure (seed did not land) makes the row INCOMPLETE and it is rerun, never scored.

Harvest after the batch: st-eval "return Object.fromEntries(Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith('so-v29-06lt-')).map((k) => [k, JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k))]))" into records.json; check every record.corpus equals corpus.sha256; archive records.json + runner logs to so-sessions.
Then the two rater passes below on opencode openai/gpt-6.1-sol (DeepSeek only when Sol cannot answer; record the route per row).

text: Sol's, frozen before inference; informational, never retuned.
40 frozen stuck-player situations (synthetic public stories, English; mix of quests, dormant arcs, promises, pending public checks with hints, offers, and none of these):
≥1 evidence-grounded goal/thread offer in ≥85% (≥34/40). Grounded = tagged to an anchor, passes the term check, and the independent rater agrees it engages that anchor.
0 hidden-prerequisite or predetermined-outcome leaks (0/40, plus the adversarial set below; any leak counts).
Blind usefulness ≥ +0.5 on a 1–5 scale over current suggestions, paired on the same 40 situations, rater blind to arm.
No additional model call per request: exactly 1 suggestions call per ask in every row (model-call ring).
Report denominators, abstentions (rows with <3 usable), and anchors offered vs used.

scoring.rowUnit: one record = one situation x one arm = the first ask only (no Other ideas). Denominator 40 per arm; a missing/INCOMPLETE record is a fail for that row, never dropped.
scoring.F1_usable: anchored arm: count rows where rater pass A marks >= 3 lines usable (lines = record.lines, the panel's [data-so=suggestion] buttons, verbatim authored offers included). Pass if >= 36/40. Also report the mechanical count (record.usable >= 3, no rater) and the same numbers for the current arm. Abstentions = rows with < 3 usable, listed by id.
scoring.F2_grounded: anchored arm: a row passes when at least one line has record.lines[i].anchor != null (the author-view 'for:' row appears only for lines the parser tagged AND that passed groundedIn's term check) AND rater pass B answers yes for that line/anchor pair. Pass if >= 34/40. The 4 'none' rows can never pass, so the effective ceiling is 36. Open: whether offer/check-help anchors count as 'goal/thread' (strict reading: objective, quest-step, quest, thread, dormant-thread, promise, pattern only).
scoring.F3_leaks: both arms, all 40 rows plus help lines and greyed rows: automatic needle scan (case-insensitive substring of each situation's leakNeedles over lines, help, greyed) flags candidates; rater pass A also judges every line against the situation's hidden facts. A leak = a line or panel row that states or implies a hidden prerequisite or a predetermined outcome (rater yes), or any needle hit the adjudicator cannot clear as coincidental wording. Pass only at 0. Report needle hits, rater flags and adjudication separately.
scoring.F4_usefulness: rater pass A, paired and blind: each situation shows both line sets as Set 1 / Set 2 in an order drawn from sha256(corpus sha + situation id) (bit 0 = anchored first), each set scored 1-5. Delta = mean over 40 of (anchored - current). Pass if >= +0.5. Also report median delta, wins/ties/losses, and the CI by paired bootstrap (1000 resamples, seed = corpus sha).
scoring.F5_one_call: both arms: record.asks === 1 in every row (rows of snapshot.modelCalls with role 'read:suggestions' since the panel opened). Any 0 or 2+ fails the floor; a failed/timed-out ask (record.failed or record.timedOut) still counts its calls.
scoring.report: denominators per floor and arm; abstentions; anchors offered vs used per row = authorRow 'anchors a, b, c' (offered kinds) vs distinct non-null line anchors (used); offline expected candidates (expect.computed) vs live authorRow kinds, mismatches listed (a mismatch means the live seed and the offline simulation disagree and the row's F2 needs a look, not a retune).

rater.route: opencode openai/gpt-6.1-sol; DeepSeek fallback only when Sol cannot answer, recorded per row; never the memory model that wrote the suggestions

passA.input: story premise; what the player can see (record.playerView sections + last 12 messages, identical across arms because the seed is identical; take it from the anchored record and assert equality); hidden facts = the situation's bait sentence + leakNeedles; Set 1 and Set 2 lines with no tags, anchors, help line or greyed rows

passB.why: grounding can only be judged with the anchor text; anchored arm only, separate session from pass A so pass A stays blind
passB.input: per tagged line: the line and its anchor text (record.lines[i].anchor), plus the playerView
